meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你查 Azure 配额(服务限制)与当前用量,对比不同区域还剩多少可用容量,必要时提交配额提升请求。它走 Azure CLI 的 az quota 命令,脚本一次调用返回限额、用量和剩余可用量。
howto.when: 当你提到 “check quotas”“quota exceeded” 等关键词,或要规划部署、验证容量、挑选区域时触发。

say.text: 对比几个候选区域,看哪个 standardDSv3Family 剩余配额最多
say.note: 逐区域列出限额、用量、可用量

say.text: 把我的 standardDSv3Family 配额申请提到 500
say.note: 提交配额提升请求并查看状态

howto.what_en: Claude checks Azure quotas (service limits) and usage, compares capacity across regions, and can submit quota increase requests. Uses Azure CLI `az quota`; one script call returns limit, usage, and available capacity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "check quotas", "quota exceeded" etc., or ask to plan a deployment, validate capacity, or pick an Azure region.

say_en.text: Check quotas and usage for Microsoft.Compute in eastus
Compare candidate regions for remaining standardDSv3Family quota
Request a quota increase for standardDSv3Family to 500
